content: Dynamic batching pitfalls: larger batches increase throughput but p99 latency climbs (12.7ms to 35.8ms in benchmarks). Static policies fail with dynamic traffic. Head-of-Line blocking when heterogeneous requests in same batch. Transformer models cannot modify batch mid-processing due to internal state length requirements. Timeout handling is critical - requests waiting in batch queue need bounded wait times. Exponential scheduling complexity in multi-model/multi-GPU.
